name: Funerals
overview: Scripture teaches that in the face of death and mourning, believers find comfort and strength in the Lord's presence and care. The Lord is portrayed as a shepherd who provides and sustains, especially to those with broken hearts and contrite spirits. Jesus promises blessing and comfort to those who mourn, encouraging faith in God and Himself as a source of peace amid sorrow. Ultimately, the hope of everlasting life through belief in Christ assures believers that death is not the end.
